title: Compress a file into XZ format
summary: Use the xz command to compress a single file into the highly efficient .xz format. By default, the original file is deleted after compression.

steps.explain: Run xz with the path to the file you want to compress. The original file will be replaced by a .xz file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file to compress

alternatives.explain: Keep the original file after compression.
